title: Compacting surface charge layers for efficient charge transfer toward stable Zn anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5319-5332
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01092F, Paper
Sinan Zheng, Yang Wang, Bin Luo, Kun Zhang, Leilei Sun, Zhean Bao, Guosheng Duan, Dinghao Chen, Hanwei Hu, Jingyun Huang, Zhizhen Ye
An electron transfer-mediated EDL compression mechanism effectively shortens Zn2+ transport paths and reduces hydrolysis through hydrogen bond confinement to H2O, achieving ultra-long cycling of over 1000 h at 10 mA cm−2.
